# Maneuver adjustment

Used in [Air Game — air combat and flak](/rules/air/70-air-combat-and-flak).

## Table

| Differential | Adjustment |
|---|---|
| 0 | 0 |
| 1–3 | 1 |
| 4–7 | 2 |
| 8–14 | 3 |
| 15–20 | 4 |
| 21+ | 5 |

## Notes

- Air-Air Combat Maneuver Adjustment Chart, 45.4, chart page 11 (jp2 105). Read twice, from the archive.org scan and the community chart PDFs (Shared Charts.pdf p. 11): 0 of 6 cells differ.
- differential is the absolute difference of the two aircraft's maneuver ratings; the more maneuverable aircraft gains the adjustment on its TacAir differential and the other loses it.
